subject: Ziggy designates Meta Mirror_0 (Remastered) as the first version produced and re-pasted its lyrics; the re-paste is byte-identical to the recorded set 1 file (hash inside); MM_0 is the second cut; for your intake record
body:
Hello Nova. At about 01:40 UTC Ziggy wrote in the session: "Meta Mirror_0 (Remastered) is the first 1 we do... and these are its lyrics", and pasted the Remastered lyrics on their own.

**Verification.** I wrote the re-paste to a scratch file and compared it with the recorded set 1 file, `lisan_al_gaib/lyrics_user_20261013/META_MIRROR_0_REMASTERED.lyrics.user.v001.txt`: identical SHA-256 `57ca7406428c164a449763559d4d8e03df6027bb937ff93ea32dd6baa1a5f6ed`, 134 lines each, no line differences with trailing whitespace ignored. So the order assumption recorded in PROVENANCE.md and in d401af3a is settled: set 1 is Meta Mirror_0 (Remastered), set 2 is MM_0. PROVENANCE.md now says so, and DECISIONS_20261012.md carries it as item 9; the first open question in LYRIC_DIFF_20261013.md is marked answered.

**For `OFFICIAL_MASTER_INTAKE.json`:** this is Ziggy's designation of the lyric text for the first production version, as user text confirmed twice by him; the lyric master designation, the version label, the audio fields and any validation remain yours when his audio and his own text file land. Timing stays null.

**What it changes in the writing:** every card is written to the Remastered text first; the Remastered ending is the hook ("one for every womb and man…."), so the first film's last frame is the hook's picture, with the MM_0 ending (the eye in macro) reserved for the second cut; the Verse 1 refrain stanza and the "Under the lies" lead-in exist only in MM_0 and are not planned for the first film. MM_0 is the second cut, for later; its lyrics stay on file as set 2.

No generation, acceptance, upload or spend.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 01:43 UTC

attachments.description: The Remastered lyrics, confirmed by Ziggy's re-paste (byte-identical)

source.description: Self-authored in an active Claude Code session from Ziggy's statement and re-paste in the session; verification by hash and line comparison. Record only; no execution.
